summary: Ash Kalra coauthored SCR 105 (September 2025) calling for the end of the humanitarian crisis in Gaza and the immediate release of all hostages, and in January 2025 posted on X drawing a parallel between LA wildfire displacement and Palestinian suffering. CAIR Action endorsed him and Vote for Peace rated him an Ally, but a California Jewish Democrats Support endorsement offsets those signals. His documented condemnation stops short of explicitly naming Israel or calling for an end to U.S. military aid.
